class.name: JRPGTable
class.brief_description: A JRPG database table whose entry IDs are their positions.
class.description: An ordered list of [JRPGEntry] objects of one class. The ID of an entry is its position plus one, and IDs never move: entries are not reordered, [method clear_entry] resets an entry instead of removing it, and [method set_maximum] only adds or removes entries at the end. Each entry is saved as a sub-resource named after its kind and ID (for example [code]Item_42[/code]), so saved tables stay stable and easy to compare.

method.name: clear_entry
method.description: Resets the entry with the given [param id] to its default values. The entry object and its ID stay the same.

method.name: get_entry
method.description: Returns the entry with the given [param id], or [code]null[/code] when [param id] is [code]0[/code] ("none") or outside the table.

method.name: get_kind
method.description: Returns the kind of the table's entries (see [method JRPGEntry.get_kind]).

method.name: get_maximum
method.description: Returns the number of entries, which is also the highest ID.

method.name: has_entry
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if an entry with the given [param id] exists.

method.name: set_maximum
method.description: Sets the number of entries. New entries are added at the end with default values; when the table shrinks, entries are removed from the end. Other data that still refers to removed IDs then refers to "none".

members.member: The entries in ID order. Entries that are [code]null[/code] when assigned are replaced by default entries so the IDs after them keep their positions.
The class of the table's entries. It can only change while the table is empty.
Version of the table's data format, used to upgrade tables saved by older versions.

constants.constant: The largest number of entries a table accepts.
